events.description:

events.title: Early Bird Social
events.partner_name: San Diego County Parks and Recreation
events.description:
Join park rangers Saturday, August 1 at 8 a.m. for a peaceful early morning walk through the beautiful 90-acre El Monte County Park. We’ll identify the birds we encounter and visit the park’s animal ambassadors—including hawks, owls, and a kestrel!

RSVP to El Monte staff at (619) 443-1474.

Note: Please use the staging lot located just before the park entrance on the left side of the road. It opens at 8 a.m. Look for the big yellow gates and the “El Monte Staging Lot” sign. Rangers will be there to gather everyone for the bird walk. From the staging lot, we’ll use the crosswalk to enter the back of the park before the front gates officially open at 9:30 a.m.

Inclement weather may cancel. For more information, call: (619) 443-1474.
events.location: El Monte County Park, San Diego

events.title: Stargazing and Night Hike with Women in the Wild
events.partner_name: San Diego County Parks and Recreation
events.description:
When the sky is full of stars, moonlit paths take on a creepy hue - the perfect shade for seeking out nighttime critters like bats and scorpions. That’s what you can experience if you arrive on time for our Star Party! We kick things off with a short and optional ranger-led twilight hike.

Back at the staging area, amateur astronomers set out giant telescopes to share different vantage points of stellar phenomenon above for a truly out-of-this-world experience. Dress warm and bring a flashlight (red- or amber-light preferred).

All children must be accompanied by an adult.

Cloud cover or inclement weather may cancel. Call Ranger Kyle ahead for weather status or if you're lost: (858) 699-8668.

This event is FREE. Parking is limited so come early, carpool, and park along the driveway if the lot is full.

For general park information, call (619) 561-0580.
events.location: Oakoasis County Preserve, 12620 Wildcat Canyon Rd, Lakeside, CA 92040, USA

events.title: Star Party at Oakoasis
events.partner_name: San Diego County Parks and Recreation
events.description:
Visit real astronomers from the San Diego Astronomy Association and look through their big, beautiful telescopes at Mother Nature's night light display.

The evening starts off with a short, ranger-led, twilight hike down our HAUNTED TRAIL at 6 p.m., just for October!

It may be too cold to see bats and scorpions, but it should be a great night for stargazing! The evening continues with stars and refreshments.

Come early to get a good parking spot and face your lights away from the telescopes so when you leave you won't blind them. Dress warmly and bring a flashlight.

Cloud cover or inclement weather may cancel. Call Ranger Kyle ahead for status or if you're lost: 858-699-8668.

For general park information: 619-561-0580
events.location: Oakoasis County Preserve, 12620 Wildcat Canyon Rd, Lakeside, CA 92040, USA
